svg.aria-label: Flowchart of the Döner Street Store Manager hiring and onboarding process, 21 steps and 5 decision points across Founding Team and Admin/Payroll swimlanes: vacancy trigger, confirm budget, define screening filters, post the vacancy, publish a promoted LinkedIn listing (COP $150,000 budget), application window, receive applications, score CVs against the rubric, verify CV accuracy (education, employers, certifications, references, interview cross-check) with a CV-accurate decision looping back to scoring on failure, shortlist candidates, first interview evaluating technical qualifications and soft skills (leadership, communication, teamwork, customer service, problem-solving, adaptability, conflict management) with a meets-requirements decision, practical assessment combining a P&L/staffing scenario and a leadership/customer-service/problem-solving scenario with a passes-assessment decision, final interview, select the best candidate, submit background check with a background-clear decision, make job offer with a candidate-accepts decision, sign employment contract, file candidate record, officially hired, Day 1 orientation, week 1 shadow shifts, 30/60/90-day performance review, handoff to the Production Lab flowchart, fully onboarded.
